$comment: CFO config. Copied to config.json on first install. `currency` labels the report; `category_overrides` maps a merchant keyword -> a category, OR the reserved value 'transfer' (exclude from spend/income) or 'income' (force-keep as income, overriding transfer auto-detection); `goals` are set by the agent via chat and persisted here + in memory; `watch_enabled`/`watch_folder`/`watch_globs` drive folder-watch auto-import (off by default — when on, the open CFO page polls the folder and auto-imports statements from already-known accounts).
